fields.label: Product Name
fields.description: The official name used to identify the loan product in the system, reports, and member communications.

fields.label: Product Code
fields.description: A unique alphanumeric identifier used internally by the system for configuration, accounting, and reporting.

fields.label: Product Description
fields.description: A clear statement of the product's purpose, target users, and general conditions.

fields.label: Product Category
fields.description: Classification of the product (e.g., development loan, emergency loan, asset financing, education loan).

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: The legal tender in which the loan is denominated and repaid.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date from which the product becomes available for disbursement.

fields.label: Review Date
fields.description: The date on which the product terms will be reviewed for relevance and profitability.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: The current lifecycle state of the product (draft, pending approval, active, suspended, retired).

fields.label: Membership Required
fields.description: Indicates whether the applicant must be a registered member of the SACCO before applying.

fields.label: Minimum Membership Duration
fields.description: The minimum period a member must have been active before qualifying for the loan.

fields.label: Minimum Shares Needed
fields.description: The minimum number of shares a member must hold before applying for the loan.

fields.label: Share Value
fields.description: The monetary value of one share as defined by the SACCO constitution.

fields.label: Minimum Share Balance
fields.description: The minimum monetary value of shares a member must maintain throughout the loan period.

fields.label: Share Ratio
fields.description: The relationship between the amount a member can borrow and the value of shares held.

fields.label: Share Balance by Loan Amount
fields.description: A tiered schedule that defines the minimum share balance required for each loan amount band.

fields.label: Share Lock-in Period
fields.description: The period during which shares cannot be withdrawn or transferred while a loan is active.

fields.label: Consequences of Share Withdrawal
fields.description: The action taken if a member's share balance falls below the required minimum during the loan period.

fields.label: Share Top-up Requirement
fields.description: Whether a member must purchase additional shares to qualify for a higher loan amount.

fields.label: Loan Type
fields.description: The structural nature of the loan (term loan, revolving credit, overdraft, emergency advance).

fields.label: Minimum Principal Amount
fields.description: The lowest amount that can be disbursed under this product.

fields.label: Maximum Principal Amount
fields.description: The highest amount that can be disbursed under this product.

fields.label: Minimum Tenor
fields.description: The shortest repayment period allowed.

fields.label: Maximum Tenor
fields.description: The longest repayment period allowed.

fields.label: Restricted Loan Term
fields.description: Conditions that limit the tenor based on loan type, collateral, or category.

fields.label: Repayment Frequency
fields.description: How often installments are due (monthly, bi-weekly, weekly, bullet).

fields.label: Amortization Method
fields.description: The method used to calculate principal and interest split over the loan period.

fields.label: Grace Period
fields.description: A period before the first installment is due.

fields.label: Moratorium
fields.description: A period during which only interest is paid, or no payment is made.

fields.label: Installment Due Date
fields.description: The specific day of the month or week on which repayments are due.

fields.label: Loan Cycle Limit
fields.description: The maximum number of concurrent loans a member can hold under this product.

fields.label: Category Restriction
fields.description: Indicates whether the loan is limited to specific member categories.

fields.label: Category Code
fields.description: A unique identifier for each eligible category.

fields.label: Category Name
fields.description: The name of the member category eligible for the loan.

fields.label: Category Description
fields.description: A definition of who belongs to the category.

fields.label: Category Loan Ceiling
fields.description: The maximum amount a member in that category can borrow.

fields.label: Category Tenor Ceiling
fields.description: The maximum tenor available to that category.

fields.label: Category Interest Adjustment
fields.description: Any interest rate variation applied to that category.

fields.label: Category Verification Requirement
fields.description: The documents or proof needed to confirm category eligibility.

fields.label: Category Priority
fields.description: The order in which categories are served if funds are limited.

fields.label: Gender Restriction
fields.description: Indicates whether the product is open to all genders, restricted, or preferential.

fields.label: Eligible Genders
fields.description: The gender categories allowed to access the product.

fields.label: Gender-Based Conditions
fields.description: Any special terms applied to a specific gender.

fields.label: Affirmative Action Allocation
fields.description: The percentage of loan funds reserved for a specific gender.

fields.label: Gender-Based Pricing Adjustment
fields.description: Any interest rate or fee adjustment applied based on gender.

fields.label: Gender Verification Requirement
fields.description: The documentation required to confirm gender eligibility.

fields.label: Gender Reporting Requirement
fields.description: Whether the system must produce gender-disaggregated reports.

fields.label: District Isolation Applied
fields.description: Indicates whether the product is restricted to specific geographic areas.

fields.label: Operational Districts
fields.description: The list of districts where the product is available.

fields.label: Branch Mapping
fields.description: The branch or office responsible for each operational district.

fields.label: Residency Requirement
fields.description: The minimum period an applicant must have lived in the district.

fields.label: Proof of Residence
fields.description: The documents accepted as evidence of residence.

fields.label: Non-Operational District Rule
fields.description: The action taken when an applicant resides outside an operational district.

fields.label: Cross-District Borrowing
fields.description: Whether a member from one district can borrow in another.

fields.label: District Loan Cap
fields.description: The maximum percentage of the loan portfolio that can be allocated to one district.

fields.label: District Reporting Requirement
fields.description: Whether the system must produce district-level portfolio reports.

fields.label: Interest Rate Type
fields.description: Whether the rate is fixed or variable over the loan period.

fields.label: Nominal Annual Interest Rate
fields.description: The stated annual rate used to calculate interest.

fields.label: Effective Interest Rate
fields.description: The true cost of the loan after compounding.

fields.label: Interest Calculation Basis
fields.description: The day-count convention used for interest computation.

fields.label: Interest Accrual Method
fields.description: How interest is accrued over the repayment period.

fields.label: Pricing Tiers
fields.description: Risk-based or category-based rate bands.

fields.label: Tier Criteria
fields.description: The conditions that qualify a borrower for each tier.

fields.label: Interest Adjustment Rules
fields.description: Conditions under which the interest rate may change.

fields.label: Interest Capitalization
fields.description: Whether unpaid interest is added to the principal balance.

fields.label: Early Repayment Allowed
fields.description: Indicates whether a borrower may repay before the scheduled maturity.

fields.label: Early Repayment Penalty
fields.description: Any charge applied for repaying ahead of schedule.

fields.label: Interest Forgiveness Rule
fields.description: A condition where interest is waived for borrowers who meet defined performance criteria.

fields.label: Qualifying Performance Criteria
fields.description: The standards a borrower must meet to qualify for interest forgiveness.

fields.label: Qualifying Period
fields.description: The portion of the loan tenor during which the borrower must perform well.

fields.label: Forgiveness Scope
fields.description: The portion of interest that is waived.

fields.label: Forfeiture Conditions
fields.description: Events that disqualify a borrower from interest forgiveness.

fields.label: Application Method
fields.description: Whether forgiveness is applied automatically or upon request.

fields.label: Accounting Treatment
fields.description: How forgiven interest is recorded in the general ledger.

fields.label: Loan Application Form Fee
fields.description: A fee paid before the application process begins.

fields.label: Application Form Fee Refundable
fields.description: Whether the form fee is refunded if the loan is not approved.

fields.label: Loan Application Fee
fields.description: A fee charged for processing the application, paid at disbursement.

fields.label: Application Fee Deduction Method
fields.description: Whether the fee is deducted from the principal or paid separately.

fields.label: Collateral Required
fields.description: Indicates whether the loan requires security.

fields.label: Collateral Category Code
fields.description: A unique identifier for each collateral type.

fields.label: Collateral Category Name
fields.description: The name of the collateral type.

fields.label: Collateral Description
fields.description: A definition of what falls under the category.

fields.label: Maximum Loan-to-Value Ratio
fields.description: The maximum percentage of collateral value that can be lent.

fields.label: Valuation Requirement
fields.description: Whether a professional valuation is required.

fields.label: Valuation Frequency
fields.description: How often collateral must be revalued.

fields.label: Collateral Documentation
fields.description: The documents required to perfect the security.

fields.label: Collateral Insurance
fields.description: Whether insurance is mandatory for the collateral.

fields.label: Collateral Registry
fields.description: Whether the collateral must be registered with a public registry.

fields.label: Collateral Release Condition
fields.description: The conditions under which collateral is released to the borrower.

fields.label: Collateral Substitution
fields.description: Whether collateral can be replaced during the loan period.

fields.label: Guarantor Required
fields.description: Indicates whether the loan requires one or more guarantors.

fields.label: Minimum Number of Guarantors
fields.description: The least number of guarantors acceptable.

fields.label: Maximum Number of Guarantors
fields.description: The highest number of guarantors allowed.

fields.label: Guarantor Types Accepted
fields.description: The categories of guarantors permitted.

fields.label: Member Guarantor Requirements
fields.description: The conditions a SACCO member must meet to guarantee.

fields.label: Non-Member Guarantor Requirements
fields.description: The conditions a non-member must meet to guarantee.

fields.label: National ID Attachment
fields.description: Whether a signed copy of the national ID must be attached.

fields.label: Guarantor Verification
fields.description: The process of confirming the guarantor's identity and capacity.

fields.label: Amount Guaranteed
fields.description: The specific monetary value each guarantor covers.

fields.label: Guarantor Liability Type
fields.description: Whether liability is joint, several, or proportional.

fields.label: Guarantor Exposure Limit
fields.description: The maximum amount a guarantor can cover across all loans.

fields.label: Guarantor Release Condition
fields.description: The conditions under which a guarantor is released.

fields.label: Guarantor Substitution
fields.description: Whether a guarantor can be replaced during the loan period.

fields.label: Guarantor Default Consequence
fields.description: The action taken against a guarantor if the borrower defaults.

fields.label: Minimum Age
fields.description: The youngest age at which a member can borrow.

fields.label: Maximum Age at Maturity
fields.description: The oldest age at which a borrower must have repaid the loan.

fields.label: Employment Status
fields.description: The required employment condition of the borrower.

fields.label: Minimum Income
fields.description: The lowest income level required to qualify.

fields.label: Credit Score Requirement
fields.description: The minimum credit score acceptable.

fields.label: Debt-to-Income Ratio
fields.description: The maximum proportion of income that can go to debt repayment.

fields.label: Membership Duration
fields.description: The minimum period of active membership required.

fields.label: Savings History
fields.description: The savings behavior required before qualifying.

fields.label: Repayment History
fields.description: The past repayment performance required.

fields.label: Documentation Required
fields.description: The documents the applicant must submit.

fields.label: Underwriting Approval Level
fields.description: The authority level required to approve the loan.

fields.label: Exception Handling
fields.description: The process for approving loans outside standard criteria.

fields.label: Disbursement Method
fields.description: How the loan funds are released to the borrower.

fields.label: Disbursement Timing
fields.description: The time between approval and release of funds.

fields.label: Disbursement Authorization
fields.description: The officer or system level that authorizes disbursement.

fields.label: Application Fee Confirmation
fields.description: Whether the application fee must be confirmed before disbursement.

fields.label: Repayment Method
fields.description: How the borrower repays the loan.

fields.label: Repayment Source
fields.description: The account or income source from which repayment is made.

fields.label: Auto-Debit Setup
fields.description: Whether automatic deduction is configured.

fields.label: Repayment Allocation Order
fields.description: The order in which payments are applied to fees, interest, and principal.

fields.label: Prepayment Handling
fields.description: How early payments are treated.

fields.label: Restructuring Policy
fields.description: The conditions under which a loan can be restructured.

fields.label: Refinancing Policy
fields.description: The conditions under which a loan can be refinanced.

fields.label: Write-off Policy
fields.description: The conditions under which a loan is written off.

fields.label: Principal Ledger Account
fields.description: The general ledger account that holds the loan principal.

fields.label: Interest Income Account
fields.description: The general ledger account for interest earned.

fields.label: Fee Income Account
fields.description: The general ledger account for fees earned.

fields.label: Penalty Income Account
fields.description: The general ledger account for penalties earned.

fields.label: Loan Loss Provision Account
fields.description: The general ledger account for provisioning.

fields.label: Write-off Account
fields.description: The general ledger account for written-off loans.

fields.label: Provisioning Policy
fields.description: The rules for setting aside funds for expected losses.

fields.label: Provisioning Matrix
fields.description: The percentage provisioned based on days past due.

fields.label: Income Recognition Policy
fields.description: When interest and fees are recognized as income.

fields.label: Suspense Account
fields.description: The account used for unallocated or unidentified payments.

fields.label: Reversal Policy
fields.description: The conditions under which transactions can be reversed.

fields.label: Audit Trail Requirement
fields.description: The level of detail the system must record for audit purposes.

fields.label: Prepared By
fields.description: The officer who drafts the product definition.

fields.label: Reviewed By
fields.description: The risk officer who reviews the product for risk exposure.

fields.label: Approved By
fields.description: The authority that grants final approval.

fields.label: Approval Date
fields.description: The date the product is approved.

fields.label: Approval Reference
fields.description: The reference number of the approval.

fields.label: Version Number
fields.description: The version of the product definition.

fields.label: Change Log
fields.description: A record of changes made to the product over time.
